name: RNA-seq
scope: GEO counts, provenance/design gates, DESeq2 QC/figures, ORA and GSEA adapters
remaining: Full FASTQ-to-count production execution and SEQC truth-set parity are separate from the successful live count-matrix case. Uploaded teaching counts have no independently established raw-read provenance.

name: Consensus sequencing
scope: Compact-reference alignment, consensus/variant and degraded-state contracts
remaining: Synthetic/compact-reference fixtures do not certify genome-scale calling, ClinVar/VEP completeness or clinical accuracy.

name: BLAST
scope: Program/database guards, parsing, provider failures, native exact-scope Swiss-Prot recovery
remaining: Remote NCBI availability remains an external dependency. Custom uploaded databases, DIAMOND and broad-taxonomy production workloads are not certified by Swiss-Prot positive controls.

name: Pairwise alignment
scope: Global/local alignment, scores, coordinates and statistical helpers
remaining: Live sample alignment completed. Comprehensive UniProt feature-track overlays and permutation-calibration parity are not established by this sample.

name: Multiple sequence alignment
scope: Alignment engine adapters, conservation and deterministic column filtering
remaining: A full editable alignment workspace and large benchmark corpus remain outside the observed page and regression checks.

name: Phylogenetics
scope: NJ/UPGMA, ML adapters, model validation and honest bootstrap provenance
remaining: IQ-TREE adapter tests do not establish executed ModelFinder selection or external evolutionary-tree accuracy.

name: Domains
scope: InterPro/UniProt feature coordinates and asynchronous result handling
remaining: Domain-to-MSA overlays and multi-homolog architecture comparison were not demonstrated end to end.

name: Motif scanner
scope: Curated/custom PROSITE-style pattern scanning
remaining: Pattern scanning is distinct from MEME-style de novo motif discovery; discovery/enrichment validation was not established.

name: UniProt
scope: Identifier, annotation, sequence and schema adapters
remaining: Full record-track/link integration and arbitrary-source availability require representative live runs beyond unit fixtures.

name: Sequence utilities
scope: Sequence arithmetic, translations/ORFs, curated restriction enzymes and GenBank annotation
remaining: The observed UI offers 13 curated enzymes. A full enzyme catalog, codon-usage comparison and cloning equivalence are not certified.

name: Dot plot
scope: Bounded sequence-window identity/substitution plots
remaining: Genome-scale minimap2/MUMmer alignment plotting was not established. A pairwise bridge currently embeds sequence input in its URL.

name: Structure analysis
scope: Geometry, confidence/missingness and export contracts
remaining: A MolProbity/wwPDB-equivalent full clash/rotamer validation and physical APBS electrostatics have not been established.

name: Structure preparation
scope: Input validation, cleanup and honest missing-dependency contracts
remaining: PDB2PQR/PROPKA protonation, PDBFixer missing-atom repair and licensed loop modeling are not certified by cleanup tests.

name: Pocket analysis
scope: fpocket parsing/provenance and separately labeled exploratory hints
remaining: The redocking panel shows five first-ranked-pocket/site mismatches. P2Rank and calibrated druggability were not established.

name: Structure comparison
scope: Structural geometry and Foldseek comparison adapter
remaining: Binding-site/ligand superposition and a representative external US-align/Foldseek benchmark remain unverified.

name: Structure prediction
scope: ESMFold/AlphaFold retrieval and failure/shape contracts
remaining: The visible tool is ESMFold. ColabFold/Boltz complex/ligand prediction and new-sequence experimental validation are not established.

name: SWISS-MODEL
scope: Repository retrieval/input validation
remaining: Repository lookup does not implement a new template-selection/alignment/MODELLER/refinement workflow.

name: Molecular dynamics
scope: Short implicit-solvent OpenMM, force-field gates, staged execution and analysis
remaining: The hosted UI caps production at 20 ps. Long convergence, explicit-solvent production and MM-GBSA are not certified.

name: Function hints
scope: InterProScan/InterPro2GO evidence and asynchronous completion
remaining: Evidence counts are not functional probabilities. eggNOG/DeepFRI-equivalent performance and novel-function correctness remain unverified.

name: Docking
scope: Vina output, pose/artifact, interaction and native redocking contracts
remaining: Fresh full panel failed 2/10: five pocket-site failures, two chemical-parsing failures and one RMSD failure. No affinity or screening-accuracy claim.

name: ADMET
scope: RDKit descriptors, named rule filters and explicitly heuristic estimates
remaining: Source labels ADME/toxicity as heuristics, not trained ADMET-AI models. Applicability-domain and external predictive accuracy remain unverified.

name: Pathway analysis
scope: Pathway adapters, ORA/GSEA data contracts and enrichment recovery
remaining: Causal-network/IPA equivalence is not established. The UI offers KEGG, while RULES.md restricts KEGG use in a monetized fallback; commercial configuration/terms need review.

name: Protein interactions
scope: STRING native confidence, evidence channels and a live TP53 network
remaining: Live result returned 12 partners. UI scale text is stale and unrelated docking copy appears. Full community/network/export parity is not certified.

name: Primers
scope: Primer3 nearest-neighbor thermodynamics, binding and amplicon checks
remaining: Supplied-template/in-silico PCR does not establish genome-wide primer-BLAST specificity or laboratory PCR success.

name: Utility tools
scope: Backend formatting, sequence operations and validation endpoints
remaining: EMBOSS-scale converters and full FASTA/GenBank/GFF validation breadth are not certified.

name: Interpretation and evidence
scope: Streaming/grounding regressions, deterministic RNA-seq explanation and live PPI AI output
remaining: Live PPI explanation raised a numeric grounding warning for its 12-item count. Grounding is distinct from expert-reviewed biological correctness.
